subject: Security & Compliance add-ons — bundling and tiered discounting
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@orchardhealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 09:15:00 -0400
Subject: Security & Compliance add-ons — bundling and next steps

Hi Samir,

Thanks again for the time on Thursday. Per our discussion, I’m attaching a concise pricing pack with options for audit logs, customer-managed KMS/HSM, and data residency. High-level options:

- Standalone add-ons (month-to-month)
- Bundled security pack (audit logs + KMS + single-region residency) with a 12-month commitment option
- Tiered discount schedule for committed token/embedding throughput (TU) and multi-region needs

I highlighted two paths we usually see work for customers in healthcare: a) 12-month committed bundle with a modest up-front discount, or b) monthly add-ons with no commitment but higher unit pricing.

Quick ask: can you confirm whether Orchard prefers an annual commit or prefers to keep these as month-to-month add-ons? If you’re open to a 12-month term I can run a finance-approved tiered discount for you; if not, I’ll outline the month-to-month rates.

Attachments: redwood-security-addons-pricing-v3.pdf, SOW-Orchard-Initial-Draft.docx

Would you be available for a short 20-min call Monday to run through numbers and SLA language?

Best,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-1212

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@orchardhealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Orchard Health Procurement <procurement@orchardhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Security & Compliance add-ons — bundling and next steps

Marcus —

Thanks for the packet. A few immediate concerns from procurement and our security team:

1) The standalone KMS/HSM price looks high relative to our expectations — we need clarity on whether that is a flat managed service fee vs. per-key usage.
2) Data residency fees: we have a distributed footprint and might need multi-region residency; want to understand marginal cost per extra region.
3) Discounts: we’re evaluating multiple vendors. To make this work in our procurement model we’d need either an enterprise commitment discount (tiered by TU) or an initial promotional credit. Month-to-month pricing with no discount will be a non-starter if the add-ons double our inference cost.

Also, procurement asked for your standard HIPAA addendum and a one-page summary of audit log retention and export formats. Can you return those?

We’re aiming to make a decision in the next 21 days, but total landed cost will determine whether we proceed with Redwood or an incumbent.

—Samir
Head of Platform Operations | Orchard Health
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@orchardhealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2026 11:45:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Security & Compliance add-ons — bundling and next steps

Samir — thanks for the clear asks. Below is an outline of a finance-approved proposal (numbers shown are illustrative and final pricing will be in the SOW):

Bundle A — 12-month committed security pack (recommended)
- Audit logs: $0.20 per 1k log events (ingest) with 12 months retention included
- KMS/HSM (managed key service): $1,000/month flat + $0.02 per key operation beyond 250k ops/month; or customer-managed KMS option with a $600/month connectivity/admin fee (no per-op charges)
- Data residency (single region): $1,800/month
Bundle price (commit): base bundle $2,700/month; with a 12-month TU commitment we can offer a 12% platform-level uplift discount on add-on units (effectively ~10-15% off list for common usage profiles)

Month-to-month (no commit)
- Audit logs: $0.28 per 1k events
- KMS/HSM managed: $1,400/month flat
- Data residency per region: $2,400/month

Tiered discounting proposal (if Orchard commits to annual TU tiers):
- 0–50M TU/month: standard rates
- 50–200M TU/month: 8% off add-on unit fees
- 200M+ TU/month: 15% off add-on unit fees + waived onboarding fee for residency

Promotional option: sign within 14 days and Redwood will provide a one-time first-year 15% credit on add-on charges (applies to audit logs and KMS/HSM only), subject to a 12-month term.

I’ve attached an updated pricing PDF and an initial SOW that maps to the bundle above. If this looks directionally correct I’ll ask finance to produce an approved quote and break down the numbers at the TU tier we discussed in the demo.

Call: I’m available Thu 10–11am or Fri 2–4pm ET.

Thanks,
Marcus

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@orchardhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2026 09:30:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Security & Compliance add-ons — bundling and next steps

Marcus — saw the thread. You have discretionary authority to offer a 10% one-time signing discount on the bundle if Orchard signs the 12-month commitment within 14 days. Escalate to me if they request more than 10% — I can approve an extra 5% on a case-by-case basis but need a one-paragraph business case (expected ARR, strategic value).

If they push for multi-region residency at scale, route to Finance for a capacity credit (we can offset some of the per-region fees with reserved GPU commitments).

Laura
Sales Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@orchardhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2026 16:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Security & Compliance add-ons — legal & contracting notes

Folks — brief legal notes to include in the SOW/amendment before quoting final price:

1) KMS/HSM: we can support both Redwood-managed keys and Orchard-managed keys (bring-your-own-KMS). For customer-managed KMS the contract needs a connectivity SLA and a clause that specifies key-rotation responsibilities. We cannot accept responsibility for external KMS configuration.

2) HIPAA addendum: attach standard addendum (I’ve uploaded amendment-kms-hsm-template.docx). We should avoid committing to SOC 2 Type II deliverables on a customer timeline; instead offer our SOC 2 report under NDA and commit to timely evidence uploads in the customer portal.

3) Audit logs: default retention is 12 months; we can extend to 36 months for an added fee. Provide export in newline-delimited JSON and support S3 export to customer bucket (extra setup charge applies).

Marcus — include the above as bullets in the SOW and don’t promise per-key indemnities. If Orchard requests waived onboarding fees for multi-region residency, route that ask to me and Finance for approval.

Neha Kapoor
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
